reset.ownerOnly: Only the OWNER account can request a global data reset.
reset.recoveredNotExecuted: Maintenance was restored, but no data purge was performed. This nonce has been discarded. Load and explicitly confirm a fresh preview before any new deletion.
reset.confirmationRequired: Load the preview, type the exact confirmation phrase, enter the owner's current password and acknowledge the deletion.
reset.invalidRequest: The reset request is invalid. No success has been confirmed.
reset.challengeInvalid: This confirmation nonce is invalid. A new preview and explicit confirmation are required.
reset.challengeExpired: This preview has expired. An unexecuted reset requires a new preview and confirmation.
reset.previewChanged: The inventory changed since the preview. No deletion was started with this preview; review a new one before confirming.
reset.inProgress: A reset is already in progress. Wait, then retry this same operation without requesting a new nonce.
reset.reauthFailed: The owner's current password is incorrect. Reenter it to retry the same operation.
reset.backupFailed: The mandatory private backup failed. The reset is not confirmed. Correct the backup problem before retrying the same operation.
reset.failed: The server could not confirm completion. Do not start a different reset; retry the same confirmation nonce.
reset.maintenanceRestoreFailed: The server reports that data deletion completed, but maintenance restoration failed. This operation is not fully finished. Retry the same nonce to restore maintenance without deleting again.
reset.invalidResponse: The server response is incomplete or invalid. Success cannot be confirmed. Retry only the same operation if a reset was submitted.
reset.requestFailed: The request failed; no successful reset is confirmed. If execution was submitted, retry only the same operation.

bulkDelete.unavailable: This selection is unavailable, already being processed, protected, outside your ownership scope, or no longer permitted. No further deletion was sent for this record.
bulkDelete.tooMany: The selection exceeds the deletion batch limit. Reduce the selection.
bulkDelete.empty: Select at least one eligible record from the loaded filter.
bulkDelete.failed: Deletion could not be confirmed. The record remains listed.
bulkDelete.profileInUse: This configuration is linked to data plans. Remove the links explicitly first; automatic cascade deletion is not allowed.

requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Please retry.
network: Unable to connect to the service. Check your network and retry.
badRequest: Some parameters are invalid. Check the form fields.
notFound: The requested resource could not be found.
conflict: The data has changed or is already in use. Refresh before retrying.
unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your session is preserved; please retry.
server: The service could not process the request. Please retry later.
maintenance: Maintenance is in progress. Please retry later.
rate_limit: Too many requests. Please wait before retrying.
rateLimitDelay: Too many requests. Retry in {{seconds}} s.
sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again
refreshUnavailable: Session renewal is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.

device.suspended: The device is temporarily suspended. Its session and configurations are preserved; reactivate it if its access is still valid.
device.disabled: The device is disabled: VPN access is blocked without deleting the account or configurations. Reactivate it if its access is still valid.
device.expired: Device validity has expired. Renew the device to extend this access and obtain a new code. Extending a plan is not enough.
device.revoked: Device activation has been revoked. Device renewal is required; simple reactivation is not enough.
device.deleted: The device was deleted. Refresh the list before a new activation.

configuration.suspended: This plan is temporarily suspended. Its profile and device activation are preserved.
configuration.expired: This plan has expired. Extend the plan without renewing the device activation code.
configuration.exhausted: This plan has run out of data. Add data to the existing plan without changing device activation.
configuration.revoked: This plan is revoked: only its mobile profile is removed. The device stays activated.
configuration.deleted: This plan was deleted: only its mobile profile is removed. The device stays activated.

validationIssue.multiple: The value must be a multiple of {{multiple}}.
